instruction: Read the patient chart in the source. The signed notes are given oldest first - COMPARE them and write the direction of change into Assessment; never repeat the last note's Assessment unchanged. Draft the visit note for the visit scheduled in the reporting period, in SOAP form. Anything in 'recent events' must be reflected. Anything the doctor must verify on arrival goes first in Plan as a checklist. Leave Objective as labelled blanks - never invent a measurement. Begin with the patient code and the visit date. The doctor rewrites and signs - the draft is never the record. This patient is newly admitted after a COPD exacerbation - there may be few or no signed notes yet. Build the draft from the chart material (conditions, medications, discharge event) and track the SpO2 values it mentions; state plainly what a first full visit must establish. If the chart lists no next visit, say so plainly in the draft and do not invent a date.
description: SOAP form for the visit in the reporting period; the SpO2 trend across the given notes is stated; Objective has no invented measurements.
